# KPI (`kpi`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs.js from schema.json. Edit the schema, then run `npm run docs`. -->

One headline number with an optional change indicator and trend line.

**Use when:** The user wants a single headline metric at a point in time: a total, count, average, or rate (open AR, tickets this week, win rate).

**Don't use when:** Several values need comparing across categories (use bar_chart) or the user needs individual records (use table).

**Sizes:** S (default), M

## Fields

Fields from `id` to `note` are shared by every widget.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"kpi"` | yes | Always "kpi". |
| `id` | string | yes | Unique id within the dashboard: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, e.g. "open-ar". |
| `title` | string | yes | What the widget shows, in sentence case with no trailing period, e.g. "Revenue by rep, Q3 2026". |
| `subtitle` | string |  | Optional one line of context under the title: scope, filter, or unit. |
| `size` | `"S"` \| `"M"` |  | Width on the 12-column grid (S = 3, M = 6, L = 9, full = 12). Allowed: S, M. Default: `"S"`. |
| `note` | string |  | Optional footnote: caveats, definitions, or why data is missing. |
| `value` | number or null | yes | The metric as a raw number, never pre-formatted text. Use null when there is no data and explain why in note. |
| `format` | `"number"` \| `"integer"` \| `"currency"` \| `"percent"` |  | How value is displayed. percent expects a fraction: 0.45 shows as 45%. Values of 10,000 or more are abbreviated ($412.3K). Default: `"number"`. |
| `delta` | object |  | Change versus a comparison period. |
| `delta.value` | number | yes | The change. With format percent (the default), a fraction: 0.082 shows as +8.2%. |
| `delta.format` | `"percent"` \| `"value"` |  | percent shows a percentage change. value shows the change in the KPI's own format, e.g. +$12.4K. Default: `"percent"`. |
| `delta.label` | string | yes | What the change is measured against, e.g. "vs last month". |
| `delta.good_direction` | `"up"` \| `"down"` |  | Whether an increase is good (revenue: up) or bad (overdue AR: down). Controls green vs red. Default: `"up"`. |
| `sparkline` | list of number |  | Optional trend, oldest first, ending with the current value. Shows shape only, no axis. |

## Example

```json
{
  "type": "kpi",
  "id": "open-ar",
  "title": "Open AR",
  "size": "S",
  "value": 412300,
  "format": "currency",
  "delta": { "value": -0.083, "label": "vs last month", "good_direction": "down" },
  "sparkline": [468000, 455200, 449800, 431000, 425600, 412300]
}
```

## Checks beyond the schema

- Warns when a percent value looks like a whole number (45 instead of 0.45).
- Warns when a percent delta looks like a whole number (8.2 instead of 0.082).
